purpose: explain why room.startgame reaches the start request but never builds an mmstart command

breakpoints.label: BeforeCbuf
breakpoints.note: the call to 0x632070 receives EAX=0 from 0x631E90; the start request then queues no command

playlist_patch_experiment.observed_result: Still no mmstart hit, no Com Error, and the screen stayed black. Changing only the playlist id is insufficient.

interpretation: The native start request calls the mmstart constructor 0x631E90, but it returns NULL. The local room has playlist id -1 and gametype -1; the local playlist adapter deliberately publishes -1 to avoid an empty online season. The start request then passes NULL to 0x632070, queues nothing, and leaves the frontend in a black waiting state. The next fix must supply a minimal valid local playlist/gametype, or bypass 0x631E90 with a verified native map-start path; do not fabricate a loaded map from the black screen.
cleanup: Run terminated by the coordinator after the observation. tools/net_rollback.ps1 reported no guard/client processes, no CODOL WFP filters, a firewall baseline match, and working DNS/loopback/ports.
